speaker: Na
text: It’s only ten thousand dong a bottle.

speaker: Na

speaker: Bo
text: Oh, man! Now I want milk tea so bad!

speaker: Na
text: Oh, come on! If you want some, I’ll buy it for you. I’m rich, you know!

speaker: Bo
text: Yay! Then, can you get me a cup of milk tea and a bánh mì, please?

speaker: Na
text: Okay, Bo! As long as you’re happy!
